questions: Should the CDF be calculated per column independently, or across the entire DataFrame as a single distribution?
Is the CDF defined over the observed unique values (as in reference) or over the full integer range from min_value to max_value-1?
Should the CDF be normalized (divide by total counts) to range [0,1], or left as cumulative counts?
For empty DataFrame (length=0), should the returned DataFrame have zero rows (as in reference) or raise an error?
Are min_value and max_value inclusive or exclusive for integer generation? (e.g., is max_value attainable?)
Should the CDF DataFrame's index be the sorted unique values (as in reference) or a sequential integer index?
If a column has repeated values, should the CDF have one row per unique value (as in reference) or one row per original row?
Should the random integer generation use a uniform distribution, or is another distribution (e.g., normal) acceptable?
